notes.title: Community Update: Release date announcement
notes.content:
Hi everybody, 

It's with [u]MEGA[/u] excitement that I can announce that our auto battler is releasing VERY soon... 

[h3][b]Kādomon is coming to Early Access March 25th! 🍌 [/b][/h3] 

[previewyoutube=BSgNWDVP2XA;full][/previewyoutube]

This Early Access version will feature [b]over 200 Kādomon[/b], new bosses, loads of awesome music and more. I can't wait for you to build your teams and experiment with different strategies! Early Access is just the beginning, and there's loads more to come in the future!

[h3][b]Check out our Early Access roadmap[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/1e28955320d59df8bad10fc4e61e3ca8ab1825c4.png[/img]

[h3][b]How much will Kādomon cost?[/b][/h3]

There will be a 10% Discount for the first week at £7.19 / €8.99 / $8.99 (US) / $13.05 (AUD)

After that, the price will change to [b]£7.99 / €9.99 / $9.99 (US) / $14.50 (AUD)  [/b]

[h3][b]Join us on Discord![/b][/h3]

If you'd like to share your winning teams with other players, discuss your favorite Kādomon, and enter our fan art competition, [url=https://discord.gg/PCZMj4CJqS][b]come join our official Discord[/b][/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/088e69d1bdb9ae637ae6ff9878c11f1c3e353fd7.png[/img]

Cheers for all your ongoing support. If you have any questions about our launch into Early Access please let me know in the comments. :) 

Talk soon, 

Pat

notes.title: New Kādomon coming to the full game!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

Firstly, a [b]BIG[/b] thanks to everyone who has played the prologue. ([b]Over 380 reviews at Very Positive![/b]) 
Your feedback has been so helpful and lovely to read, and it's really helped me know what to focus on. 
Secondly, I wanted to take some time to show you a few of the newly announced Kādomon coming to the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2125540/Kdomon_Hyper_Auto_Battlers/][b] full game launching very soon[/b][/url]. 🍌

[h2][b]We've announced 4 new Kādomon! [/b][/h2]

There will be [b]over 200 Kādomon[/b] in the full game, and we've been showcasing some of the quirky creatures you'll be able to battle in Early Access. 💚

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/b94e50737f74642cf50b26e144092616afbf21c1.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Paranoot -> Paraswoop -> Paraflight
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/5703d4c0cb12789dff0a3b80fd83c372ea6d5676.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Cactot -> Cactamari -> Krakulent
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/64bce471084cb7139ba340e515d9f57e60ebd645.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Expendibill -> Platypunk -> Plodfather
[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/252999a5937b761ac7f0b7453b9a0dc7ed6018cc.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Coldent -> Fluffirn -> Capybaric[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/12e0705e2c7f7b735bb80c0e178425b069a3b569.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Your Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/h2]
I’ve noticed a couple questions popping up within the community, and I wanted to take some time to answer them:

[h3][b]How do I Hyper-evolve my Kādomon?[/b][/h3]
In the prologue, Beleaf, Monku, and Creeze can all be hyper-evolved. All you need to do is equip them with a specific item once they’ve evolved into their third form, and then give them some XP (by either releasing a Kādomon into the wild, battling, or an event).

In the full game, [b]EVERY Kādomon[/b] will have the ability to hyper-evolve and become even more powerful! There’s loads of cool Kādomon hyper-evolution designs that I can’t wait for you to discover.

[h3][b]Will there be Steam Achievements?[/b][/h3] 
Yep, in our 1.0 release. 🏆

[h3][b]How many Kādomon types are there?[/b][/h3]
There will be 12 types of Kādomon in the Early Access release of the game (if we include Gnock who has their own type!) with more planned to come in future updates. 🐛

[h3][b]What is a misprint/how do I get one?[/b][/h3]
A misprint is a rare color variant of a Kādomon! Every Kādomon has an additional 2 color variants that can randomly appear. The more common misprint has a 1/1000 chance of appearing in battle, whilst the rarer version has a 1/2000 chance. ✨

When you defeat a misprint in combat, you either need to complete the run with it, or go to the nearest camp to send it home to unlock it. Be wary, if you are defeated you will lose the misprint! 

Thanks for all your continued support. You can wishlist the main game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2125540/Kdomon_Hyper_Auto_Battlers/][b]here[/b][/url]. 

Talk soon!

Pat

notes.title: The Kādomon prologue is now live!
notes.content:
Hey Professors 👋

I'm super excited to finally say that the Kādomon prologue is now live on Steam! After having such an amazing reception to the game on Discord, the prologue is now ready to play for everyone. 

[h2][b]Collect, assemble, and battle your team![/b][/h2]

This [b]free-to-play version[/b] has loads of content for you to play, and even more will be coming to the full game later this year. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/227e637c5488ec42babc8089090437e9ceffe5bb.png[/img]

[h2][b]Introducing a new Kādomon: Malarky[/b][/h2]

We took a poll on Discord for which should be the next Kādomon added to our autobattler, and Malarky was the winner! Malarky (along with their two evolutions, [b]Hammarc [b]&[/b] Thoraladon[/b]) is a [b]Water/Lightning[/b] type and jumps about within your team as they attack. 🦈

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/180061f7c755b3e285ed22f63908153faaa45183.png[/img]

[h2][b]Start building your Kādodex today![/b][/h2]

So far our Discord community has already played over [b]2,100 hours[/b]! A [u]BIG[/u] thank you to everyone who has played so far, and if you can, a review would be really appreciated. As a solo indie dev, support from players is incredibly helpful to to getting Kādomon noticed. Your feedback already has been amazing, and I hope you enjoy this new and improved version of the game! 💙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44655608/1c069b260263638ea2b250ad2e85c19578b2005b.gif[/img]

If you'd like to join the community on Discord and share you strategies, [b][url=https://discord.gg/gfJKUkp6na]click here[/url][/b]. 🍌

Talk soon!

Pat

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.1.7
notes.content:
Hi everyone, happy launch day! To kick things off, we've made some more updates:

[h3][b]Major Additions [/b][/h3]
A new unit line has been introduced – the Water/Lightning Kadomon, Malarky. 
3 New Items have been introduced. 
8 new Field Effects have been introduced – focusing on giving players the ability to invert certain typings. 

[h3][b]General Gameplay Adjustments [/b][/h3]
Carefoal's Passive Effect has been reworked – dealing damage and applying fast to allies behind when the ally in front of it attacks. 
Shroonobi's Passive Effect has been nerfed, triggering enemy team's Decay 1/1/2 times. 
Acroney's Passive Effect has been reworked, granting allies bonus Attack on faint as well as the currently granted Health. 
The Air type synergy has been adjusted –granting Fast at the start of a battle, rather than triggering Attacks on start. 
'Toxic Slime' item has been buffed, applying 2 Decay rather than 1. 
Enemies will now correctly place their units in the queue (using Tanks at the front, specialists in their required spots, etc.). 
Enemies now have the chance to spawn holding an item. 
Queenstruction now spawns holding the 'Umm-brella' item. 
The 'Quick Cash' Field Effect has been nerfed – granting 5 Gold rather than 10 Gold. 

[h3][b]Misc. [/b][/h3]
Shonkka's Shop now stocks units according to their rarity tier. 
Items can now be sold in the Shop. 
Items marked with 'Consume' will now be consumed on Battle Start, but persist across Battles. 
Icons on the top bar have been updated to new artwork. 
A tooltip has been added on the Battle Stats screen when the Fragile keyword is activated. 
New music tracks have been added for Rest Areas and Random Events. 

[h3][b]Bug Fixes [/b][/h3]
Corrected XP Display for Hyper Evolved units. 
Fixed 'On ally spawn' items not triggering correctly. 
Fixed an issue causing Mini Boss encounters to break certain UI elements.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.1.6
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we've added some more fixes to our game:

[h3][b]General Gameplay Adjustments [/b][/h3]
Scaling EXP for releasing Kadomon removed. 
The amount of energy required to activate Turtorts super has been increased from 17 to 21.  
Skemu's passive has been updated to deal decay to random enemies when ally supers are used.  
Skemu's super has been updated to trigger all decay and heal the ally ahead for a percentage of damage dealt.  
Frosmol's passive has been updated to gain stacks of slow equal to the enemies total number of stacks upon attacking. 
Frosmol's super has been updated to turn all stacks of slow on Frosmol into stacks of damage up, then triggering Frosmol to attack.  
Urchice's passive ability has been updated to summon an urchburg upon fainting, applying all stacks of decay and slow on Urchice to its enemies.  
Urchice's super has been updated to gain 3 stacks of Decay and 2 stacks of Slow.  
Urchbergs passive has been updated to upon attacking, trigger stacks of Decay upon its target.  
Urchbergs super has been updated to deal 2 stacks of slow to all enemies.  

[h3][b]Misc. [/b][/h3]
Slowed down the movement animations in battle.  
The Energy icon has been updated to a star with a lightning bolt inside to visually link closer with the star icons in passives.  

[h3][b]Bug Fixes [/b][/h3]
Fixed a bug that caused Acroneys Health to not match up to the number of scrap parts consumed upon summoning.  
Fixed a bug that caused Turtort to activate its passive twice upon battle start.  
Fixed a bug that caused Slamala to redirect attacks from more enemy Kādomon than intended.  
Fixed a bug that caused hover card effects not to show whilst trying to sell a shop unit.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.1.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we've added a few more updated to the game. Thanks for all your feedback so far!

[h3][b]General Gameplay Adjustments [/b][/h3]
- All units have received adjustments to their base stats, according to their Role and Rarity - increasing unit variety across the board. 
- Shockka's Passive will now activate when Any Ally ahead is hit, rather than also activating for Allies behind. 
- Turtort's Super has had it's required Charge reduced from 31 to 17. 
-Sardien's Passive now grants less Attack and Fast - 1/2/3 for both, rather than 2/4/8 and 1/2/4 respectively. 
-When unsheltering an Ally on Faint, Turtort now grants said ally 1/2/3 Fortitude. 
- 'Overgrowth' and 'Flower Field' Field Effects now grant Kadomon Max Heath. 
- 'Rock Solid' Field Effect now reduces 2 incoming damage, rather than 5. 
- 'Weird Tome' Field Effect now grants 2 bonus Gold, rather than 5. 

[h3][b]Misc. [/b][/h3]
- The setup screen Bench now displays 6 open slots, rather than an empty bench - resolving issues with card switching. 
- Temporary removed the ability to replace units by hovering. 
- Screen Resolution should now save correctly in the settings menu. 
- Reverted change from 0.1.4 regarding skipping Items and Field Effects, they can now be skipped again. 

[h3][b]Bug Fixes [/b][/h3]
- Corrected an issue where values on attacks would not reset to zero after first usage. 
- Units will no longer continuously respawn when opening UI during a Random Event.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.1.4
notes.content:
Your feedback has been fantastic, and thanks to you we've made more updates:

[h3][b]General Gameplay Adjustments[/b][/h3] 
-'Skip Reward' is now no longer displayed for Items and Field Effects. 
- Peeling and Scorpet can no longer heal a unit beyond its maximum health points. 
- Zipstrat's Passive Ability has been adjusted, now granting the ally ahead 2/4/8 Energy on Attack. 
- Shockka's Passive Ability now grants Ally behind Energy, rather than all Allies. 
- Octostritch's Super Ability now heals Allies equal to enemies toral decay for 50%, rather than 60%. 
- Acroney's Passive Ability has been adjusted to heal allies. 
- Kadomon with the 'Shelter' keyword will now activate this ability at the start of a battle, before any other action. 
- Regen will no longer trigger at Maximum HP. 
- 'Last Wish' Field Effect now triggers on Faint. 

[h3][b]Misc. [/b][/h3]
- The Normal Attack bar is now displayed next to a unit during a battle. 
- Hyper Evolutions can now be viewed in the Kadodex once unlocked. 
- Shockka and their evolutions now appear correctly in the Kadodex. 
- Aerozard will now display the correct images 
- 'Cursed Chest' Field Effect will now grant the correct amount of Kadomon when claimed. 
- Moved the location of equipped items on cards to prevent overlapping. 
- The units on the Run End Screen now appear in the correct, reversed order. 
- Balancing improvements to Kadomon traits. 

[h3][b]Bug Fixes [/b][/h3]
- Corrected an issue where items and field effects could be incorrectly expanded with Right Click. 
- Players are no longer able to claim multiple rewards on a random event.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.1.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

More updates coming your way! Thanks for all the feedback so far, it's been great.

[h3][b]General Gameplay Adjustments [/b][/h3]
Field Effects already owned by the player will no longer appear during 'Choose a Field Effect'. 
Kadomon obtained via. the 'Cursed Chest' Field Effect now start with 0 XP. 
Queenstruction has had her speed increased from 12 to 20. 
Buffock has had its speed increased from 30 to 50. 

[h3][b]Misc. [/b][/h3]
Added a button to manually check for previous Demo version save data - allowing unlocks and misprints to be ported over. 
Corrected Misprint sprites for Howlder and Chimpyre. 
Mushinja will now display the correct name in UI. 
Gnock will no longer appear in the Shop. 
A new music track has been added for Lightning-type encounters. 

[h3][b]Bug Fixes [/b][/h3]
Misprints will now correctly unlock at the end of run, correcting an issue introduced in 0.1.2. 
The in-game resolution drop down menu should now display correctly in settings. 
'Rock Solid' Field Effect should now function correctly. 
Hovering over Kadomon in your party and on selection screens should now correctly expand their cards. 
Corrected issue where the Kadomon at the rear of a queue would not be hoverable. 
Addressed softlocks during Queenstruction boss fight.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 0.1.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone 👋

Thanks so much for playing, your feedback has been so helpful! We've been hard at work fixing the bugs you have spotted. 

Haven't played the prologue yet but would like to? Join our Discord to be first to know when the next batch of keys drop: discord.gg/PzKZqx7tuj💜


[h3][b]General Gameplay Adjustments [/b][/h3]
- 'Attack All' abilities (Rainfall, Frosmol) will no longer incorrectly deal bonus damage. 
- 'Hyper' Gameplay Speed is now even faster. 
- Changing the gameplay speed during battles will now trigger the next action – allowing battles that previously soft locked to be resolved. 

[h3][b]Misc. [/b][/h3]
- Locked off additional regions on the Map Screen. 
- Corrected Howlder's sprite appearing incorrectly on their card. 
- Toned down scrolling pattern movement on loading screens to address motion sickness concerns. 
- Allowed tooltips to be hidden in the shop, preventing items from being obstructed. 
- Sound Effects can now be muted in the Settings screen. 
- Corrected numerous grammatical errors. 

[h3][b]Bug Fixes [/b][/h3]
- Bonus XP items in the Shop now correctly charge the player on purchase. 
- Kadomon will now reset their position correctly following an attack. 
- Kadomon will no longer attempt to use their 'On Start' passive before correctly taking their place in the queue. 
- Kadomon Cards can no longer stack in the same slot on the Setup screen. 
- Purchasing Kadomon in the shop will no longer prevent their Kadodex entries from being unlocked. 
- Releasing Kadomon for Bonus XP should no longer create gameplay issues or duplicates. 
- Purchasing Kadomon in the shop should no longer result in duplicates. 
- Kadomon now sync correctly when using the Bag in Rest Areas. 
- Addressed only one Misprint form being saved when banking at a Rest Area. 
- Misprints will now correctly unlock on Run Completion. 
- Fixed repeated inputs allowing for easy Item/Field Effect duplication.
